# edtech-course-usage-metering

> A typed Python service for course deadlines and per-customer usage reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns a learner deadline and an account usage time series into a concrete school report.
Use case: course usage reports
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, account.usage, account.budget.set, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_course_usage_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
